name: petrified wood
lore_descriptor: streaked with stone-grain and mineral veins
unidentified_descriptor: a wood that seems too heavy
first_pickup_chronicle: Petrified wood. The grain runs straight but the weight is wrong — a forest that became stone and kept its shape. Fire troubles it less than it should.
design_notes: Fills peak_floor 12 gap. Dense rare wood that resists fire. Mundane (max_enchant 1) — its weight is its magic.
